name: Standing Dumbbell Strict Press
description: Stand tall with dumbbells racked at the shoulders. Ribs down, glutes and core braced, shoulders packed DOWN not shrugged up. Press overhead with the shoulders alone — no dip, no knee bend, no leg drive — until the arms lock out with the weights over the heels. Lower slowly. The legs and trunk hold the platform still; that bracing demand is the difference between this and a push press. If a rep stalls partway, a small dip to finish it turns that rep into a push press — that is the exit, not the plan.
